description: This file defines the IA-32 specific kernel interface for Zephyr OS, including macros, data structures, and function prototypes related to interrupt handling, TSS, and architecture-specific configurations.

methods.name: arch_irq_lock
methods.description: Inline function to disable interrupts and return previous interrupt state.

methods.name: arch_except
methods.description: Macro to trigger an exception with a specific reason.

methods.name: arch_isr_direct_header
methods.description: Function to handle pre-interrupt processing, including tracing and nested interrupt count.

methods.name: arch_isr_direct_footer
methods.description: Function to handle post-interrupt processing, including EOI, tracing, nested count, and potential rescheduling.

methods.name: arch_isr_direct_footer_swap
methods.description: External function to handle footer swap logic during interrupt.
